# Hasil Paudyal — Personal Portfolio

> Personal portfolio of Hasil Paudyal: App Development Manager, React Native / Expo developer, web developer, electrical engineer, hardware builder, and original poet. Based in Kathmandu, Nepal.

> Last updated: 2026-06-12

## About

Hasil Paudyal is an App Development Manager at ConvergeStack (Jan 2022–present). He holds a B.E. in Electrical & Electronics Engineering from New Horizon College of Engineering, Bangalore (2013–2017). Beyond software, he builds IoT hardware, writes original poetry and quotes, and has real-world experience as a field service & sales engineer for international industrial equipment brands.

He is the author of all poems and quotes published on this site.

LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/in/hasil/
GitHub: https://github.com/ha5il

## What He Does

- Backend & APIs in Laravel (PHP), Node.js, and Deno
- Bank & payment-gateway integrations over SOAP and JSON, with automated transaction tracking
- Fraud-detection admin panels and reporting/analytics dashboards for courier/logistics clients
- Content-managed (CMS) sites for non-technical clients
- Full-stack web platforms in JavaScript/TypeScript (Vue.js, Laravel, AWS EBS, RDS, S3, Lambda)
- Mobile apps — React Native (Expo) for iOS and Android, with custom native modules in Swift and Kotlin
- SIP/WebRTC voice calling via custom Expo native modules
- Apple TV apps with HomeKit device integration
- Serverless edge APIs and workers with Cloudflare Workers
- CI/CD pipelines and reproducible QA/staging environments
- Server automation — remote DB backups/restore, CRON jobs, queues
- Self-hosted local LLMs + workflow automation (Activepieces) for internal tasks
- Container deployments — Podman, Nexus, Docker
- IoT hardware — RFID, physical sensors, Arduino, Wi-Fi based devices
- Original poetry and prose writing

## Key IT Projects

- **BriefBoard** — KPI dashboard mobile app (iOS + Android), published to App Store and Google Play. React Native / Expo.
- **Legal Remit** — Real-time international remittance web platform. Laravel, AWS EBS, RDS.
- **VoIP Calls** — SIP and WebRTC call app with custom Expo native modules in Swift and Kotlin.
- **KTM Retail** — E-commerce for Jockey/Dixey Nepal. Vue.js, Laravel.
- **Strata Tender Management** — Tender creation and bidding portal. Laravel, Vue.js, AWS.
- **Community Events** — React Native app for creating and joining community events.
- **Limbu Dictionary** — Free online Limbu–English–Nepali dictionary. React Native, WordPress API.
- **Reachon** — Digital education platform with real-time features. Vue.js, Socket.io.

## Electrical & Electronics Projects

- RFID Limiter — Arduino Uno device limiting RFID scan frequency
- RABC Analyser — Windows console app for Danube International washer extractor analysis
- Electricity Thief Detector — Automatic supply-line remover circuit
- Device Performance Tracker — Real-time electrical device performance analyser

## Technologies

JavaScript/TypeScript, Vue.js, React Native, Expo, Swift, Kotlin, Laravel, PHP, Node.js, Deno, AWS (EC2, EBS, RDS, S3, Lambda, CloudWatch), Cloudflare Workers, Podman, Nexus, Docker, GitLab CI/CD, Arduino, MySQL, Firebase Firestore, Figma, AutoCAD, MiPower, Primavera P6. Familiar with Spring Boot fundamentals (controllers, services, repositories).

## Creative Work

Hasil writes original poetry and quotes in English. His work blends personal philosophy, wit, and wordplay. The acrostic poem "H.A.S.I.L. P.A.U.D.Y.A.L." appears in the sidebar of his portfolio and spells out his full name.

Selected quotes:
- "Not always starting from A ends you in Z, sometimes you have to continue with AA and create any word of your own."
- "If you know that I am a genius, then know that you are part of the reason."
- "Dream big, but not so big that it becomes a mess."
